scripts.test: set -a; [ -f packages/database/.env.test ] && . packages/database/.env.test; set +a; if [ "${DATABASE_URL:-}" != "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" ]; then bun run scripts/preflight-tests.ts; else echo "✅ Pre-flight already passed; DATABASE_URL is TEST_DATABASE_URL for test process."; fi && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" DIRECT_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" turbo run test
scripts.test:e2e: set -a; [ -f packages/database/.env.test ] && . packages/database/.env.test; set +a; if [ "${DATABASE_URL:-}" != "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" ]; then bun run scripts/preflight-tests.ts; else echo "✅ Pre-flight already passed; DATABASE_URL is TEST_DATABASE_URL for test process."; fi && DATABASE_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" DIRECT_URL="$TEST_DATABASE_URL" bunx playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.db:test:reset: set -a; [ -f packages/database/.env.test ] && . packages/database/.env.test; set +a; bun run scripts/reset-test-db.ts
